name: us-opportunity-zones
description: Qualified Opportunity Zone investing for tax year 2026 under sections 1400Z-1 and 1400Z-2 as amended by Public Law 119-21 section 70421. Keeps two sets of rules apart by the date money goes into the fund. Original rules (invested on or before 31 December 2026) bring all remaining deferred gain into income on the 2026 return, with the 10 and 5 percent basis step-ups only where 5 or 7 years are reached by that date. New rules (invested from 1 January 2027) give a rolling 5-year deferral, a 10 percent basis increase (30 percent for a qualified rural opportunity fund), and the 10-year exclusion capped at 30 years. Covers the 180-day window, the 90 percent fund test, substantial improvement, Form 8997 and the new fund reporting penalties. Trigger on "opportunity zone", "QOF", "qualified opportunity fund", "Form 8997", "defer capital gain into a fund", "2026 opportunity zone inclusion". Federal only.
